title: Fourth Wall SMP Magic
description: A new magic system to the Fourth Wall SMP
body:
Adds a new magic system specifically for the Fourth Wall SMP. This mod is made to add on to the lore of the Fourth Wall SMP. 

If you would like to join the Minecraft Roleplay SMP this mod is used in, apply with this interview form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdOiiEuZ8Eof1w4Crz-QmkpfJMfRFe_rt_mFpbITP0i6jDAxQ/viewform

## Ability Keybinds
Be sure to set keybinds so abilities can be used properly.

- Ability 1–4 are meant for base abilities.
- Ability 4 may alternatively become a maximum technique.
- Ability 5 is either a domain expansion or a maximum technique, depending on the magical technique.
- Shadow Style has two variants, simple barrier and advanced barrier.

## Features
The mod contains a working mana bar, working domain expansions, domain clash system, multiple commands, and a full fledged config to alter tweakable apsects of each magic technique even while a server is running.

## Visual Style
Currently no custom visuals, the mod uses purely vanilla particles, textures and models. But these vanilla features have been utilized to create a truly magic feel to each ability. Possible custom textures, sounds, models, particles, and HUD if I am able to get a solid artist to be able to fill that role.

## Dependencies
This mod is has two dependencies:
- Geckolib
- Player Animation Library

## Ability Information
The specifics of all abilities will not be explained in order to maintain secrecy and privacy. It is up to the discretion of the magic users of each technique to explain their abilities.

There is a simple barrier and advanced barrier shadow style technique that can be unlocked through commands that allows for players to nullify domain effects and give a slight boost while used out of domains. The simple barrier is used with the shadow style keybind while the advanced barrier is used with the shadow style keybind while holding shift.
